{{Top|leg}}
'''Oasis''' was one of the three [[Cooling Station]]s located in [[Bantha Traxx]] on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. Located on the establishment's second floor, the bar is usually tended by a woman known as [[Sha'Dria]]. Oasis was the most popular Cooling Station in Bantha Traxx.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
